sections.overview: This South American pimelodid catfish is known from Amazon tributaries in Brazil.
sections.identification: Its head is conspicuously triangular or arrowhead-shaped in top and underside views.
sections.habitat: It is a freshwater, bottom-dwelling fish.
sections.diet: The references consulted do not provide a species-specific diet account.
sections.behavior: Detailed activity and social behaviour are not reported in the sources consulted.
sections.reproduction: The sources consulted provide no species-specific breeding details.
sections.ecology: It resembles S. lima in body shape, but its triangular head is distinctive; few museum specimens are known.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern from 2018.
